reserveReview.rationale: At Scroll block 35517218 (hash 0xf25418f270b4a0be3b14c5a58db04716bb61ceb32f839144109eb212b5662734, 2026-10-27T16:15:49Z), CollateralRegistry.totalCollaterals() and getToken/getTroveManager enumerate exactly four branches. Independently reproduced division is admitted under D01; asset categories, source keys, unknown liquidity and other risk facts are unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete four-branch on-chain census at Scroll block 35517218: 18-decimal token amounts times 18-decimal protocol USD prices, divided by their total USD value 91355.8165506757838518679764014876964417; percentages independently rounded to two decimals. Protocol reference-price composition, not an independent solvency attestation.
